[[File:Dragonsnake_Bog.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Dragonsnake/Legends|Dragonsnake]] Bog on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].]]
'''Dragonsnake Bog''' was a swampy lagoon on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The bog was located near [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] [[Yoda's Hut/Legends|mud hut]].

Upon his arrival at Dagobah following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] crash-landed his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] in Dragonsnake Bog. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] plunged into the water, and was almost devoured by a [[King of the Dragonsnakes|dragonsnake]] that resided under the murky waters. Finding the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] inedible, it spat the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] out into the jungle.
